artifacts.summary: 10-phase plan deleting the three base lifecycle skill directories, landing two blocking wiring fixes, and sweeping the 129-file reference footprint to zero grep hits.

memory_candidates.content: When deleting a skill/component directory from the agent-system source store, two independent hard requirements must be fixed in the SAME change or the deletion ships a broken system: (1) validate-wiring.sh's validate_core_system() carries a literal `for skill in ...; do [[ -d ]]` existence loop naming core skills, and (2) the owning extension's manifest.json `provides.skills` array lists the directory for deploy copying. Routing lints do NOT catch either: lint-routing-wiring.sh Check A validates routing.{op} keys have routing_agents.{op} counterparts (so removing routing keys is always safe) and Check B only validates routing_agents* values name existing AGENT files -- nothing anywhere validates that a `routing` value names an existing SKILL file. Grep for the component name in both validate-wiring.sh and every manifest.json provides.* array before planning any component deletion.
